bmm roadmap

Source: ROADMAP.md

Updated 2026-11-06. The reasoning is in .dev/decisions/0008-roadmap-to-2027-03.md; the live list of work is in the GitHub milestones 1.5.0, 1.6.0 and Future.

What ships when

bmm 1.4.2 is on CRAN (6 November 2026). It fixes wrong sdm() estimates in some designs and a handful of smaller bugs; install it with install.packages("bmm").

bmm 1.5.0, CRAN submission 1 February 2027, on CRAN by mid-February. This is the release the TeaP 2027 pre-conference workshop (Mannheim, 21 March 2027) teaches from.

  • A documented description of every model, model_spec(), and simulate_data() to simulate data from any model, so that packages built on bmm (bmmtools, the model explorer) no longer read bmm’s internals.
  • The circular mixture models (mixture2p(), mixture3p(), imm()) rebuilt as custom families, with variable-precision and capacity versions. Your 1.4 code and fits keep working; two parameter names change (mu1 becomes mu, pnt becomes ptarget) and the old names warn.
  • sdm() with a Laplace activation, peak and range scalings, and discrete response options.
  • psychometric_function(), a new model for detection and discrimination data.
  • One row per trial for the signal detection and MPT models, so item random effects are possible.
  • The target confusability competition model tcc() and the EZ circular diffusion model ezcdm(), if their reviews finish before 18 December 2026; otherwise they move to 1.6.0.
  • A written policy on default priors: they change only in a minor release and are listed in NEWS.

bmm 1.6.0, CRAN submission 1 June 2027, before the MathPsych meeting.

  • Other packages can define bmm models: register_bmm_model() and a versioned model contract.
  • Change detection versions of the visual working memory models.
  • The racing models: linear ballistic accumulator, log-normal race, racing diffusion.
  • A cumulative response model for Likert items.
  • Fits record the default-prior set they used, and bmm_options(prior_version = ) reproduces an older set.
  • Multivariate models, if their interface is settled by mid-January 2027; otherwise 1.7.0.
  • The forms deprecated in bmm 0.4 and 1.0 are removed (fit_model(), IMMfull(), sdmSimple(), …), as are supported_models() and parameters(). The log default of dm3(), dmpt(), dddm(), dcswald() and dezdm() becomes FALSE.

Not planned

Models without a tractable likelihood (diffusion models for conflict tasks), models with recursion over trial sequences (reinforcement learning, trial-by-trial category learning), free-recall architectures, and simulation-based likelihoods are not planned for bmm itself. A reinforcement-learning family is a candidate for a separate package built on the extension API.

How to contribute a model

Read .github/CONTRIBUTING.md and the developer notes (https://venpopov.com/bmm/dev-notes/). In short: open an issue with the “New model” template, build the model with use_model_template(), add a recovery plan under tests/recovery/ and attach its bmmtools validation card, and open the pull request against develop (or dev-1.6.0 for a model planned for 1.6.0). A new model merges with one approving review and a green card.
